name: How long does it take to paint the interior of an entire house?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint the interior of an entire house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole home interior painting project varies depending on the size of your house, the number of rooms, ceiling height, and the extent of surface preparation required. On average, a typical 2,000-square-foot home might take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. Homes with intricate details, extensive repairs, or multiple color changes will naturally take longer. We'll provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific property during a consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies by house size and complexity, typically 3-7 days for a 2,000-square-foot home. A detailed timeline is provided after assessment.
